items.name: Dream of the Magician
items.effect: Increases DMG dealt by 8%. When casting skills, for each additional hit on 1 enemy, the DMG dealt increases by 4%, up to 12%.
items.slot4Effect: Changes the effect of [Tarot Whisper Skill] into: Increases DMG dealt by 16%. When casting skills, for each additional hit on 1 enemy, the DMG dealt increases by 8%, up to 24%.
items.recommendedFor: AoE DPS

items.name: The Fool’s Naivety
items.effect: HP is increased by 10%. When initiating an active attack, if the character’s max HP is greater than the target’s, DMG dealt is increased by 10%.
items.slot4Effect: HP is additionally increased by 10%. When initiating an active attack, if the character's HP percentage is greater than the target's, DMG delat is increased by 10%
items.recommendedFor:
Cocoa, Leonide, Guzman, Agatha, Kiya
(Any unit Scalling with HP)

items.name: Mercy of The High Priestess
items.effect: Increases healing effect by 15%.
items.slot4Effect: Increases healing effect by 15% additionally. If the target is [Dying], the healing effect further increases by 15%
items.recommendedFor:
Samantha, Inanna, Taiir, Saffiyah Alter, Aphra
(Healer or Off-healer)

detailInfo.name: Dying
detailInfo.detail: [State] When HP is below 30%, reduces DMG dealt by 30% and increases DMG taken by 30%.

items.name: Elegance of the Empress
items.effect: After casting a skill on an ally, convert 1 [debuff] on the target into a [Level 1 Buff] that lasts for 2 turns.
items.slot4Effect: After casting a skill on an ally, additionally convert 1 [debuff] on the target into a [Level 1 Buff] that lasts for 2 turns.
items.recommendedFor:
Samantha, Inanna, Taiir, Gloria
(Recomended for PvP only)

detailInfo.name: Level 1 Buff
detailInfo.detail: Buff: Including [△ ATK I], [△ Crit I], [△ P.DEF I], [△ M. DEF I], [△ Healing I].

items.name: Majesty of the Emperor
items.effect: DMG increases by 10% when attacking [Healthy] enemies.
items.slot4Effect: DMG dealt increases by 15% additionally when attacking [Healthy] enemies.
items.recommendedFor: Assassin / any damage delear relies on 1 shotting, recomended for PvP only. Niche use on PvE like UD / VoD

detailInfo.name: Healthy
detailInfo.detail: [State] Activated when HP is no less than 70%.

items.name: Hierophant’s Laws
items.effect: [AoE DMG] taken is decreased by 20%.
items.slot4Effect: When initiating a single-target attack, DMG dealt is increased by 20%. WHen initiating a single-target healing, the healing amount is increased by 20%.
items.recommendedFor:
Beryl
(Situational use where u might want to take reduced AoE DMG and increasing single target heal/dps)

items.name: March of The Chariot
items.effect: Gains [Move I] when not using any active skills and [Standby], lasting for 2 turns.
items.slot4Effect: Changes the effect of [Tarot Whisper Skill] into: Gains [Move II] when not using any active skills and [Standby], lasting for 2 turns.

Simona, Rawiyah OG, Acambe
(Recomended for PvP only)

detailInfo.name: Standby
detailInfo.detail: [State] Ends current action without conducting an [Attack Turn]. Using [Instant] skills does not count as an [Attack Turn].

items.name: Source of Strength
items.effect: When attacked by a character of [the character’s Counter Role], DMG taken is decreased by 10%. When attacking a character of [the character’s Counter Role], ignores 15% of the target’s DEF.
items.slot4Effect: When attacked by a character of [the character’s Counter Role], DMG taken is additionally decreased by 10%. When attacking a character of [the character’s Counter Role], additionally ignores 20% of the target’s DEF.
items.recommendedFor:
Saffiyah OG
(Breaker, Seeker, Defender you want to do more dmg and take less dmg from their Advantage Role & Counter Role)

items.name: Silence of The Hermit
items.effect: Decreases DMG taken by 10%.
items.slot4Effect: Decreases DMG taken by 10% additionally.
items.recommendedFor:
Magnus, Alex, Maitha, Guzman, Pamina, Nergal, Teadon

items.name: Course of Fortune
items.effect: At the start of the turn, gains 1 random [buff] of [The Wheel of Fortune].
items.slot4Effect: At the start of the turn, gains 1 additional random [buff] of [The Wheel of Fortune].
items.recommendedFor: All rounder tarot, works on anyone but any unit might have better tarot rather than using this.

detailInfo.name: Buff
detailInfo.detail: Refers to a situation that causes favorable effects on the current character.

items.effect: At the start of the battle, gains a [physical shield] equal to 25% of the character’s P.ATK plus its M.ATK. The shield cannot be dispelled.
items.slot4Effect: Decrease DMG taken by 15% when the character has a [shield]
items.recommendedFor:
Give you mediocre undispellable shield & damage reduction
(Recomended for PvP only)

detailInfo.name: Shield
detailInfo.detail: [Shield] Categorized into Physical Shield and Magical Shield, used to resist P.DMG and M.DMG respectively.

items.name: Temptation of The Devil

Dantallion, Acambe, Garcia, Kvare
(Good for situation where you want to scale in longer battle)
